questions.question: Walk me through the sales and use tax reconciliation reports you prepared at Graphic Packaging: what data did you compare, how did you investigate differences, and what was your role in resolving them?

If a sales and use tax reconciliation does not agree to the general ledger near close, how would you determine whether the cause is timing, coding, a missing transaction, or an incorrect tax treatment?
Describe a tax-related reconciliation difference you resolved. What evidence did you use, which stakeholders did you involve, and how did you confirm the final correction was appropriate?
What parts of taxation have you handled directly versus supported through reconciliation, reporting, or documentation?
What controls would you expect around sales and use tax data from invoice or subledger entry through tax return support and general-ledger reconciliation?
Suppose an invoice was recorded without the expected use tax and the month has already closed. How would you assess the issue, record any adjustment, and document the resolution?
How do you distinguish a sales tax issue from a use tax issue in an accounting workflow, and what information would you need before deciding on the accounting treatment?
How would you use general-ledger balances, subledger detail, and source invoices to build a monthly tax reconciliation from scratch?
When you find a recurring tax reconciliation exception, how would you determine whether it needs a one-time correction, a process change, or escalation to a tax specialist?
What documentation would you retain to support a sales and use tax reconciliation and make it reviewable by an auditor or tax reviewer?
